name: Bulk-Download & Anomalous-Access Alert

parameters.content:
## Bulk-Download & Anomalous-Access Alert

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers hourly and weekly schedules to fetch Google Drive activity logs from Google Workspace.
2. It processes and normalizes these activity records, filtering for relevant access events.
3. The hourly flow aggregates user access counts, checks for anomalous access locations, and compares activity against set thresholds to detect suspicious behavior.
4. Alerts are generated, logged for compliance, and emailed to admins for any anomalous access detected hourly.
5. The weekly flow aggregates total access summaries firm-wide, builds a summary report, logs it for compliance, and emails the digest weekly.
6. Both hourly and weekly branches utilize sub-workflows for logging compliance audit data.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure Google Workspace Admin API credentials for the HTTP Request nodes fetching activity logs.
- [ ] Set up email service credentials for sending alert and summary emails.
- [ ] Define anomaly thresholds and user access tracking parameters in the code nodes for hourly anomaly detection.
- [ ] Schedule the triggers according to desired intervals (hourly for anomalies, weekly for summaries).

## Hourly activity fetch and normalize

This cluster includes the hourly trigger, Google Workspace activity fetch, record splitting, and normalization of individual Drive access events.

## Hourly access filtering and aggregation

Filters access-relevant events and aggregates counts by user for anomaly detection preparation.

## Hourly anomaly detection logic

Checks for new access locations, compares user activity against anomaly thresholds, and filters users requiring alerts.

## Hourly alert construction and sending

Builds the anomalous access alert email, logs it for compliance audit, and sends the alert email to admin.

## Weekly activity fetch and normalize

Includes the weekly trigger, Google Workspace weekly activity fetch, record splitting, and normalization for the weekly summary branch.

## Weekly access filtering and aggregation

Filters access-relevant events for the weekly summary and aggregates the week's access counts and totals by user.

## Weekly summary construction and sending

Builds the weekly access pattern summary email, logs it for compliance audit, and sends the summary email.

nodes.name: Hourly Google Drive Access Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every hour on the hour. Adjust the cron expression here if your firm wants a different polling cadence — the LOOKBACK_HOURS variable should match whatever you set.

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Google Drive Activity
nodes.notes: Pulls the firm's Google Workspace Drive audit log (who viewed/downloaded/printed which file, and when) for the last LOOKBACK_HOURS. Needs a Google API (OAuth2) credential with domain-wide delegation and the admin.reports.audit.readonly scope — this is the one real setup step in this template; see the workflow doc sticky. Firms with over 1000 relevant events per hour will need pagination added (not built here — most solo/small firms won't hit this).

nodes.name: Split Drive Activity Records
nodes.notes: Breaks the audit log response into one item per access event, so each can be checked and counted individually.

nodes.name: Normalize Drive Access Event Data
nodes.notes: Extracts the user, the file, whether it was a download/print (higher risk) or just a view, and tries to recognize a matter reference in the file name.

nodes.name: Filter Relevant Drive Access Events
nodes.notes: Drops edits, creates, renames, and other non-access events — only views/downloads/prints count toward this hour's volume.

nodes.name: Aggregate Hourly Access By User
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch (not once per item) — turns the list of individual access events into one summary row per user for this hour.

nodes.name: Check User New Access Location
nodes.notes: A second, independent anomaly signal alongside the volume thresholds: flags when a user accesses Drive from an IP never seen from them before. The first hour a user is ever observed just builds their baseline silently -- nothing alerts until a genuinely new IP shows up after that.

nodes.name: Compare Access Against Anomalies
nodes.notes: The firm's actual alert thresholds live here (BULK_DOWNLOAD_THRESHOLD, ACCESS_BURST_THRESHOLD) as n8n Variables, plus a cooldown so one elevated user doesn't spam an email every hour.

nodes.name: Filter Users Requiring Alert
nodes.notes: Only users who just crossed a threshold and are off cooldown make it through to an actual email.

nodes.name: Build Access Anomaly Alert Email
nodes.notes: Writes the actual alert email content. SECURITY_ALERT_EMAIL is an optional n8n Variable if you want these routed somewhere different from general firm alerts (falls back to FIRM_EMAIL).

nodes.name: Log Access Alert For Compliance
nodes.notes: Logs the alert to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet via the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) — internal record-keeping only, not a client message. Its 'approved' result is deliberately ignored: this is an internal firm security safety net and must never be suppressible, same fire-and-forget pattern used for internal-only notifications elsewhere in this catalog (PAC-59/60/61/63/67/74).

nodes.name: Send Access Anomaly Alert Email
nodes.notes: Sends the actual alert to the firm admin. Uses the FIRM_FROM_EMAIL variable as sender and the SMTP credential configured on this node.

nodes.name: Weekly Access Pattern Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Monday 8am by default — adjust the cron expression if a different day/time suits your firm.

nodes.name: Fetch Weekly Google Drive Data
nodes.notes: Same Google Workspace Drive audit log as the hourly branch, just pulled over the trailing 7 days instead of the last hour, for a firm-wide visibility digest rather than a threshold alert.

nodes.name: Split Weekly Drive Activity Records
nodes.notes: Breaks the week's audit log response into one item per access event.

nodes.name: Normalize Weekly Drive Access Event
nodes.notes: Same field extraction as the hourly branch's normalize step, applied to the week's events.

nodes.name: Filter Weekly Relevant Access Events
nodes.notes: Same as the hourly branch: only views/downloads/prints count.

nodes.name: Aggregate Weekly Access By User
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch -- produces a single firm-wide summary row, not one row per event.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Access Summary Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'no activity this week' message rather than an empty table when the firm had zero Drive events.

nodes.name: Log Weekly Summary For Compliance
nodes.notes: Same fire-and-forget audit logging as the hourly branch's guardrail call — internal record-keeping only.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Access Summary Email
nodes.notes: Sends the weekly digest to the same recipient as the hourly alert.

description: Runs on two independent schedules. Hourly: pulls Google Workspace Drive access activity, counts views/downloads/prints per user, and emails the firm admin the moment anyone crosses a bulk-download or access-burst threshold, with a per-user cooldown so the same person doesn't re-trigger every hour. Weekly (separate): re-reads the last 7 days of the same audit log and always sends a firm-wide access summary for visibility. Reads metadata only -- who accessed which file name and when -- never document contents (ABA Op. 512). Replaces enterprise SIEM/DLP tools and manual log review.

meta.name: Notify on anomalous Google Drive access and send weekly email summaries
